items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Mulligan and I stayed up all night. Actually, that’s not true. Mulligan didn’t stay up all night

ctx.x: “If you want to drive a taxi, drive a taxi.” In other words, if that’s what you want to be, go ahead and do it. But don’t spill any of your negative thinking on me. Don’t you know who you are? All of those things were being said in just, “If you want to drive a taxi, drive a taxi.” He taught me a lesson. One night there was no money. Mulligan was there, and Gil. There was a band at the Apollo. I said, let’s – I talked to the leader of that band and asked him about you and would he like to play some of your music.…
That’s a great amount of money for that time.
